description: Find domains using field-specific WHOIS searches — e.g. `RegistrantContact.Organization`, `DomainName`, `NameServers`. Up to 4 search terms with optional exact-match and exclude flags, combined with AND. Use this when you need precision (search only the registrant org, not the full record). Do NOT use this for free-text searches (use `reverse_whois`) or when you have only the domain (use `whois`).

count_only.description: If true, returns only count (no credit usage). If false, returns domain list.

created_date_from.description: Search domains created after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

created_date_to.description: Search domains created before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

expired_date_from.description: Search domains that expired after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

expired_date_to.description: Search domains that expired before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

include_audit_dates.description: If true, includes domain list and last audit date.

punycode.description: If true, encodes domain names to Punycode.

search_after.description: Pagination needle from previous page's "nextPageSearchAfter" value.

search_terms.description: Field-specific WHOIS search term objects (max 4), combined with AND. Each object has "field" (required) and "term" (required), plus optional "exclude" and "exact_match" booleans. A JSON-encoded string of the same array is also accepted for backward compatibility.

exact_match.description: If true, exact field match instead of substring.

exclude.description: If true, exclude matching records from results.

field.description: WHOIS field to search, e.g. DomainName, RegistrarName, NameServers, Email, RegistrantContact.Organization.

term.description: Search string. Case insensitive, supports wildcards.

search_type.description: Search type: "current" or "historic". "current" searches current records, "historic" searches all records.

updated_date_from.description: Search domains updated after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

updated_date_to.description: Search domains updated before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

name: reverse_whois_advanced
